summary: Bundle of security/billing fixes: the public validateEmailDomain address no longer returns the whole status-page row (incl. password and IP allow-list), switching a page away from password protection now clears the stored password, Telegram group linking only works for the chat that completed the /start step (stops one workspace reading another's group additions), and account deletion now stops if cancelling the Stripe subscription fails instead of deleting while billing continues.

statements.why: Nothing new is dangerous (the commit closes holes), but it fixes a public leak of status-page passwords/IP allow-lists (statusPage.ts validateEmailDomain), a cross-workspace Telegram leak and a keep-billing-after-delete bug; 'nothing flagged' hides that live versions had these problems.

statements.text: Most of this change is in packages/api/src/router/stripe/shared.ts (12 lines added, 15 removed).
statements.why: Matches the diff stat (mostly re-indentation from removing try/catch).

statements.text: The agent changed statusPage.ts, stripe/shared.ts, telegram-updates.ts and page/update.ts in ways plain can't describe yet.

misses.what: Security fix: the public email-domain check on status pages was returning the full page record, including the page password and IP allow-list, to anyone; now it returns only the title. Live versions before this exposed those values.
Security fix: Telegram group linking could let any caller see another workspace's group additions; now only the chat that started the link (within 30 minutes) can finish it.

Billing fix: deleting an account used to continue even if cancelling the Stripe subscription failed (customer kept being charged); now the deletion stops with an error when Stripe fails, so users may see account deletion fail during Stripe outages.
Changing a status page from password protection to another access type now erases the old stored password.
